$comment: #FEED-219: EVERY composer keeps its own DRAFT, synced across the person's devices like the issue drafts (issue-draft.json), x4 (web `lib/composer-drafts.ts` + `hooks/use-composer-draft.ts`; desktop, iOS ExpCore `ComposerDraft.swift`, Android `domain/ComposerDraft.kt` replay this file in their own PRs). Model = pure `src/composer-draft.ts`; every mirror replays `keys`, `writes` and `fields` and compares the WHOLE expected value. STORAGE: one `composer_drafts` row per (user, key), private to its author (the shape is the static `user_id = me`, like `issue_drafts` and `pins`), carrying the team the target lives in, the key and the TEXT (attachments are never kept: a picked file stays only while the composer is open). KEYS (`keys`): the target the composer writes to, `<kind>:<id>`: `comment` = the issue's bottom comment composer (wide and the phones' sheet share it), `reply` = the reply composer under a comment card (the thread's top comment), `session` = a session's composer (a chat, an agent's conversation, a raw session, an app editor's session), `agent` = an agent's composer before its conversation exists, `app` = an app editor's composer before its first session, `newChat` = the team's New chat composer (the home and the start dialog share it). Editing an existing comment keeps no draft. An unknown kind or a missing id parses to null (a client ignores that row). WRITES (`writes`): the field's text, written `debounceMs` after the last keystroke, at once when the composer goes away (a tab switch, navigation, the page hiding) and after a send settles; a text that is empty or only whitespace DELETES the row (a send that cleared the field, an emptied field, a reply's Cancel = discard), anything else upserts it verbatim. A failed write is silent: the field keeps its text and the next write retries. FIELD (`fields`): what the field shows. Once the person has EDITED the field since the composer opened, the field is theirs (no synced row, no other device ever overwrites it); until then it shows this client's own write not yet echoed back (`local`, so a remount right after typing never flashes an older copy), else the synced row's text, else empty; so a cold load whose row arrives late fills in, and a draft sent or discarded on another device empties an untouched field. A send applies composer-send.json, then writes the field it leaves.

keys.name: an app editor before its session

fields.name: a fresh composer with no draft is empty
a reload shows the synced draft
a remount right after typing shows its own unechoed write
an untouched field follows another device's edit
an untouched field empties when the draft was sent elsewhere
an edited field is never overwritten
an edited field emptied stays empty
